footer.tagline: Natural fibres, cut with patience and made to be kept.

motionDemo.title: Worn slowly, kept for years
motionDemo.text: Every piece begins as a bolt of undyed wool or linen in a small workshop. It is cut by hand, sewn by the same pair of hands, and pressed only when it is ready — so it can be worn for a decade and still feel like the first morning.
